name: Corvex Vector DDR5 32 GB (2 x 16 GB) 6000 CL30
analog: Corsair Vengeance DDR5 32GB (2x16GB) 6000 CL30 black (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: 2 x 16 GB DDR5-6000 CL30: black aluminium spreader with a ribbed panel.
doc_notes: Two sticks: install them in slots A2 and B2 first (the second and fourth slots from the CPU) for dual channel.
Enable EXPO (AMD) or XMP 3.0 (Intel) in the BIOS to run 6000 MT/s; without it the kit runs at the JEDEC 4800 MT/s.
Rated 6000 MT/s, timings 30-36-36-76, at 1.40V.
DDR5 only: the key notch does not fit DDR4 slots.
Open the slot latches, align the notch and press both ends down until the latches click.
Touch a grounded metal part of the case before handling; hold the stick by its edges.
The first boot with new DDR5 can take a few minutes while the board trains the memory.
Peel the clear film off both sides of the heat spreader before installing.

name: Kingsland Server Premier DDR5-4800 RDIMM 32 GB ECC
analog: Kingston Server Premier DDR5-4800 32GB 2Rx8 ECC RDIMM (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: 32 GB DDR5-4800 CL40: registered ECC server module: RCD, SPD hub and thermal sensors on a bare PCB.
doc_notes: Registered ECC DDR5 RDIMM (2Rx8): server and workstation boards only. It does not fit desktop DDR5 slots (the key notch differs).
Fill slot 1 of every channel first (DIMMA1, DIMMB1, ...), following the board's population table; one DIMM per channel gives the highest speed.
Use identical modules in a channel: do not mix ranks, capacities or 3DS and non-3DS RDIMMs.
Rated 4800 MT/s CL40 at 1.10V with an on-module PMIC.
Align the notch, press both ends straight down until the latches close.
ESD-sensitive: hold by the edges and wear a grounded wrist strap.
Memory training on first boot can take several minutes on large configurations.
